criteria.contract: Current head may accept an explicitly consenting local household member personal pledge after the original reciprocal service is individually released; membership, office, private assets and obligations remain separate and busy subjects cannot silently change service

After actual head succession an unexpired old castellan original can be reauthorized once by local current head and directly bound consenting agent; preserve original expiry, ownership, old receipts and dated authority without reviving superseded appointments

Reauthorized castellan custody, local NPC administration, procurement/freight delegated budgets, dated sealed report recipients and late old reports stay attached to their distinct originals; no inventory duplication or monthly reset; An actually formed, personally known organization-party truce may be locally shown by the old representative to the actual successor, preserving exact terms/expiry and sealed old recipients; pending old-address papers do not become successor consent and retired signers cannot automatically exercise new political authority

Normal castle and personal-service screens expose valid local operations and distinguish ineffective old appointment from effective authority; unknown remote stock and unconsenting candidates are not disclosed

Wrong/stale/repeated/absent/refused/expired/forged operations, actual generation recovery and future equality, old-save compatibility and headless 3D data are verified; GUI appearance remains separate

limits: Living-head succession only: local personal pledge acceptance, unexpired formal castellan/custody reauthorization, and a formed organization-party nonaggression agreement locally shown by its original informed representative to the actual successor. No automatic personal allegiance, political authority, property, troops or old paper recipient transfer. No general alliance/hostage/marriage, multi-generation diplomatic chain, new successor confirmation courier, active-army takeover, NPC autonomous succession, death/disputes or full nationwide behavior. Full3511/GUI NOT_RUN.
